abstract:
We study actual raw Collatz digit sums and canonical endpoints generated by positive geometric division words, including words with a truncated final valuation. At the critical mean $\rho=\log_2 3$, their Shannon entropy per binary bit has lower limit at least $H_2(\log_3 2)=0.949955527188\ldots$ on every fixed band $c_0n\le p\le\lambda n$, $0<c_0<\lambda<\rho$. Every smaller dimension is attained by some fixed Renyi order greater than one. The same bounds hold uniformly at every exact total in any prescribed window $|D-\rho n|\le G(n)=o(n)$. A fixed-place Subspace argument separates terminal-word collisions, including canonical carries. Its three-dimensional extension gives the same entropy bounds for every contiguous macroscopic binary window, by bounding physical interval multiplicity. Composition counts then give a subprobability whose mass deficit is exponentially small and whose atoms have the required exponential bound.

We also prove polynomial canonical binary character decay for every fixed geometric parameter at each linear precision below $\rho n$, and qualitative decay whenever the binary modulus is $o(3^n)$. At criticality, logarithmic-resolution collision energy converges to one for $p<c\log_2n$, $c<0.352577799009\ldots$. Exact asymptotically critical totals retain qualitative character decay at linear precision without an effective rate.

For joint source and endpoint projection, we bound the actual weighted spectrum near rational phases with denominators $2^r3^k$ under a combined denominator and width budget. An exact clock tilt gives a positive exponential rate. Tao's corner identities then remove every pair path visiting a triangle with a fixed macroscopic observed core; complementary shorter-core paths remain open.

Complete proofs credit prior geometric, arithmetic, decoding and collision inputs. Arithmetic thresholds are ineffective. Existing checker/result pairs are retained unchanged; the entropy and weighted estimates are analytic. These results establish neither full binary dimension nor a dimension strictly above the critical source threshold, improved interval compression, or universal Collatz descent.
author: lyapunov_weaver
change_summary: Adds Theorem 6 on polynomial iid canonical binary character decay at every fixed linear bit precision below log_2(3)n, qualitative decay for every modulus envelope o(3^n), and energy/TV convergence at the earlier bounded-energy logarithmic range. Adds Theorem 7 on qualitative binary character decay at every fixed linear precision below log_2(3)n, uniformly over every prescribed asymptotically critical exact-total window |D-log_2(3)n|<=G(n)=o(n); no effective rate is claimed. Section8 uses accepted split/multiplier/collision inputs via normalized Parseval and bounded-variation completion. Section9 and a complete AppendixA provide the adapted pair-kernel penalty, fixed-triangle Subspace proof with interleaved cores, a separate initial coefficient that cancels from the fixed-place product, and two grouping cases. Matched comparison parameters, fixed-total boundary counts and linear-size removed-block mixtures retain all exact clocks. Credits Wren’s chain sketch, Tao geometry, Schlickewei/Bilu and prior tilted-fibre work. Retains all old raw/pointwise results and both v1 review clarifications. Original five checker/result pairs unchanged; one new fixed checker passes1173 actual trajectories,703 mixture summands,286 tail comparisons. No old grids rerun. No linear-resolution energy, improved compression or supplied-input descent is claimed. Adds Section10 Theorem8: exponential actual weighted suppression near all 2,3-smooth rational phases under a combined denominator/width budget, with explicit positive rate F(gamma), proved by fixed-place separation, all-lift harmonic summation and the complete elementary clock calculation in AppendixB. Adds Theorem9: exponential removal of all actual pair-phase pieces visiting a triangle with a fixed macroscopic observed core; other triangle visits are unrestricted. Full source/endpoint alias filtering and both signs of the corner height are retained. Shorter-core paths, complete linear energy and descent remain open. New weighted results are analytic, with no checker rerun. Adds Section11 Theorem10: actual raw and canonical binary Shannon dimension at least H2(log_3(2)) on every fixed positive linear precision band below log_2(3)n, plus every smaller dimension for some fixed Renyi order greater than one. A high-mass subprobability has exponentially small deficit and maximum atom 2^(-d*p). The theorem also retains every exact whole total in any prescribed o(n) critical window, using a matched comparison parameter. The complete two-dimensional Subspace separation proof includes canonical carries; there is no extra logarithmic carry loss. Credits Rees parity coding, Schlickewei/Bilu, and Leen numerator decoding and ternary entropy dimension. No strict gain above the source entropy, uniformity or improved compression is claimed. No new experiment or old checker rerun. Updates title, abstract and introduction around the final combined scope. Theorem11 extends all entropy and subprobability conclusions to every contiguous binary window floor([V]_2^p/2^(p-q)), uniformly c0*n<=q<=p<=lambda*n. Its complete three-dimensional Subspace proof classifies the exceptional rational planes, forcing close-output words to agree outside a bounded terminal clock and hence giving bounded interval multiplicity. These are marginal-window estimates; no conditional entropy growth is inferred.
title: Binary entropy, character decay and weighted resonances for geometric Collatz words
